findings.title: HSTS sent over insecure HTTP and will be ignored
findings.remediation: Serve HSTS only over HTTPS and redirect HTTP traffic to HTTPS according to deployment policy.

findings.title: Referrer-Policy missing
findings.remediation: Set an explicit referrer policy appropriate for the application.

findings.title: Secure cookie set from an insecure HTTP origin
findings.evidence: __Host-session: Secure=true HttpOnly=true SameSite=Strict PathPresent=true PathIsRoot=true DomainPresent=false Partitioned=false
findings.remediation: Set Secure cookies from HTTPS. Some user agents make localhost exceptions, but do not rely on insecure origins for production cookies.

findings.title: Cookie prefix requirements are not satisfied
findings.evidence: __Host-session: Secure=true HttpOnly=true SameSite=Strict PathPresent=true PathIsRoot=true DomainPresent=false Partitioned=false
findings.remediation: Ensure __Secure-, __Host-, __Http-, and __Host-Http- cookie prefix requirements are satisfied and set prefixed cookies from HTTPS.

findings.title: Content-Security-Policy present (partial analysis)
findings.remediation: HeaderLens does not claim a generic CSP PASS from header presence alone. Review effective directives in browser context; avoid unsafe-inline/unsafe-eval where feasible and account for nonces/hashes/strict-dynamic.

findings.title: Permissions-Policy not present
findings.remediation: Consider restricting browser features that the application does not use.

findings.title: Server header discloses implementation detail
findings.remediation: Remove unnecessary version/product disclosure where practical.
